models_evaluated: self-supervised pre-trained cough audio deep learning model

links.outcome: Model AUC across clinical, crowdsourced, and open-source datasets
links.effect: AUC 0.79 for clinical data and 0.69 for crowdsourced data; poor detection performance on open-source datasets shows limitation of existing models.
links.quote: The area under receiver operating characteristic curve is 0.79 for clinical data and 0.69 for crowdsourced data, indicating differences between clinical validation and real-world application.

screen.reason: The study conducts an extensive external validation of acoustic AI for COVID-19 detection across diverse subgroups and datasets, but focuses on model diagnostic performance and generalizability limitations rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
